name: Document profiler
description: Inventory deletion hypotheses and measure explicit interventions on disposable document copies. Counts are inventory, never estimated RAM or cost.

entrypoints.name: Find unsheeted mechanical plans
entrypoints.description: Read-only metadata: non-template mechanical plans, actual sheet placements and primary/dependent relationships. Keeps directly unsheeted parents whose dependents are sheeted. No activation or geometry.

entrypoints.name: Census Revit read cost
entrypoints.description: Run with NoTransaction; starts no transaction and stops if the document is modified. Samples first-touch memory per element, link and context categories by id, orientation frames and fidelity hints before any product read is designed. Every row says measured, sampled or projected.

entrypoints.name: Profile document
entrypoints.description: Read-only bounded census and repeated API workloads. Writes machine-readable evidence; does not rank counts as cost.

entrypoints.name: Compare deletion interventions
entrypoints.description: Opt-in, disposable copy only, NoTransaction. Repeats sham/deletion/rollback controls; does not measure rendered UI or reclaimed RAM.

entrypoints.name: Save deletion variant
entrypoints.description: Opt-in, disposable copy only, NoTransaction. Commits one configured intervention and saves a NEW variant for external fresh-process comparisons.

entrypoints.name: Measure view-opening calls
entrypoints.description: Opt-in, foreground disposable copy only, NoTransaction. Measures activation, refresh and supported zoom calls, then verifies view/tab/zoom restoration. Does not measure pixels or FPS.
